Regulatory OK expands routes of administration, potentially widening uptake and adherence in a key market.
Home dosing can lower treatment burden and capacity constraints, supporting faster patient starts.
Comparable exposure supports efficacy parity vs. IV, reducing clinician hesitancy.
Fewer systemic reactions may improve persistence and reduce monitoring costs.
Japan is third country to approve
Global SC rollout momentum de‑risks broader adoption and royalty ramp for BioArctic.

This is a mid-cycle expansion of Leqembi’s label, adding a more convenient route likely to support adoption. A larger catalyst would be rapid reimbursement listing enabling at‑home use and evidence of accelerated patient starts or sales inflection.
